import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import Circle, FancyArrowPatch from matplotlib.font_manager import FontProperties
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 11, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "svg.fonttype": "path", "lines.linewidth": 1.5, })
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" OCHRE = "#D4A72C" INK = "#263238" GRAY = "#AAB4B9" LIGHT = "#DCE2E4"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 3.8), dpi=100) fig.patch.set_facecolor("white")
fig.text(0.155, 0.91, "Complex exponential\nbasis entry", ha="center", va="top", fontsize=12, fontweight="semibold", linespacing=1.35) fig.text(0.435, 0.91, "Complex conjugate reflects\nacross real axis", ha="center", va="top", fontsize=12, fontweight="semibold", linespacing=1.35) fig.text(0.775, 0.91, "Projection formula substitution", ha="center", va="top", fontsize=12, fontweight="semibold")
# The angle is schematic, not a measured or specified numerical value. theta = 0.78 px, py = np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta)
def complex_plane(bounds): ax = fig.add_axes(bounds) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_xlim(-1.28, 1.46) ax.set_ylim(-1.25, 1.29) ax.axis("off") ax.add_patch(Circle((0, 0), 1, fill=False, edgecolor=LIGHT, linewidth=1.35)) ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (-1.20, 0), (1.30, 0), arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=8, linewidth=1, color=GRAY)) ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (0, -1.16), (0, 1.19), arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=8, linewidth=1, color=GRAY)) ax.text(1.34, -0.08, "Re", fontsize=9, ha="left", va="top") ax.text(0.07, 1.17, "Im", fontsize=9, ha="left", va="bottom") ax.text(-0.09, -0.10, "0", fontsize=8, ha="right", va="top", color="#657786") ax.text(1.01, -0.10, "1", fontsize=8, ha="center", va="top", color="#657786") return ax
def angle_arrow(ax, angle, color): radius = 0.44 a = np.linspace(0, angle, 80) ax.plot(radius * np.cos(a), radius * np.sin(a), color=color, linewidth=1.6) ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (radius * np.cos(a[-7]), radius * np.sin(a[-7])), (radius * np.cos(a[-1]), radius * np.sin(a[-1])), arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=10, linewidth=1.4, color=color))
left = complex_plane([0.035, 0.355, 0.245, 0.435]) left.plot([0, px], [0, py], color=BLUE, linewidth=1.8) left.scatter([px], [py], s=32, color=BLUE, zorder=5) angle_arrow(left, theta, BLUE) left.text(0.56, 0.22, r"$+\theta_n$", color=BLUE, fontsize=10, ha="left", va="center") left.text(px + 0.10, py + 0.09, r"$u_{k,n}$", color=BLUE, fontsize=11, ha="left", va="bottom")
middle = complex_plane([0.315, 0.355, 0.245, 0.435]) middle.plot([0, px], [0, py], color=GRAY, linewidth=1.1, linestyle=(0, (3, 3))) middle.scatter([px], [py], s=28, facecolors="white", edgecolors=GRAY, linewidths=1.1, zorder=5) middle.plot([px, px], [-py, py], color=LIGHT, linewidth=1.1, linestyle=(0, (2, 3))) middle.plot([0, px], [0, -py], color=TEAL, linewidth=1.8) middle.scatter([px], [-py], s=32, color=TEAL, zorder=5) angle_arrow(middle, -theta, TEAL) middle.text(0.53, -0.25, r"$-\theta_n$", color=TEAL, fontsize=10, ha="left", va="center") middle.text(px + 0.10, -py - 0.04, r"$\overline{u_{k,n}}$", color=TEAL, fontsize=11, ha="left", va="top")
fig.text(0.155, 0.285, r"$u_{k,n}=\cos(\theta_n)+i\sin(\theta_n)$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11.5, color=BLUE) fig.text(0.155, 0.215, r"$=e^{+i\theta_n}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=15, color=BLUE) fig.text(0.155, 0.125, r"$\theta_n=2\pi kn/N$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11)
fig.text(0.435, 0.285, r"$\overline{u_{k,n}}=\cos(\theta_n)-i\sin(\theta_n)$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11.5, color=TEAL) fig.text(0.435, 0.215, r"$=e^{-i\theta_n}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=15, color=TEAL) fig.text(0.435, 0.125, "Same real part; opposite imaginary part", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8.5, color="#657786")
rx = 0.602 fig.text(rx, 0.725, r"$c_k=\dfrac{\langle u_k,x\rangle}{\langle u_k,u_k\rangle}$", ha="left", va="center", fontsize=16) fig.text(rx + 0.027, 0.565, r"$=\dfrac{1}{N}\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}\overline{u_{k,n}}\,x_n$", ha="left", va="center", fontsize=15) fig.text(rx, 0.425, r"Substitute $\overline{u_{k,n}}=e^{-i\,2\pi kn/N}$", ha="left", va="center", fontsize=11, color=TEAL)
# Typeset the final exponential in separate runs so only its minus sign # is highlighted, while preserving the formula exactly. base = fig.text(rx, 0.265, r"$c_k=\dfrac{1}{N}\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}x_n\,e$", ha="left", va="baseline", fontsize=15) fig.canvas.draw() renderer = fig.canvas.get_renderer() base_box = base.get_window_extent(renderer) exponent_x = base_box.x1 / fig.bbox.width + 0.001 exponent_y = 0.265 + 0.036 minus = fig.text(exponent_x, exponent_y, r"$-$", color=OCHRE, fontsize=12, fontweight="bold", ha="left", va="baseline") fig.canvas.draw() minus_box = minus.get_window_extent(renderer) fig.text(minus_box.x1 / fig.bbox.width, exponent_y, r"$i\,2\pi kn/N$", fontsize=11, ha="left", va="baseline", color=INK)
# A short leader connects the explanation specifically to the exponent sign. minus_center = ( (minus_box.x0 + minus_box.x1) / (2 * fig.bbox.width), minus_box.y0 / fig.bbox.height ) fig.add_artist(FancyArrowPatch( (0.795, 0.177), (minus_center[0], minus_center[1] - 0.006), transform=fig.transFigure, arrowstyle="-", connectionstyle="angle,angleA=90,angleB=0,rad=4", color=OCHRE, linewidth=1.5)) fig.text(0.775, 0.125, r"Minus sign comes from $\overline{u_{k,n}}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10, color=INK)
fig.text(0.5, 0.035, r"Discrete Fourier basis: $n=0,\ldots,N-1$, integer $k$; " r"$\langle u_k,u_k\rangle=N$. Angles are schematic (radians).", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8.3, color="#657786")
